abilities.label: Storm Talon
abilities.description: A native climb-and-dive carries a tailwind to you: +12% movement speed for 4 seconds. Only 4 damage (6 if marked); consumes the mark. 10-second support cooldown.
abilities.automatic: Marks an engaged threat, then dives to refresh your tailwind when a token can be spared.

abilities.label: Mark Weakness
abilities.description: A wing-spread screech marks one visible enemy for 5 seconds. Free; the next dive consumes its small 2-damage bonus.
abilities.automatic: Marks the current threat before her next dive.

abilities.label: Sky Survey
abilities.description: Investigate a discovered trace or survey nearby ground to reveal traps. Free; available to your one equipped companion.
abilities.automatic: Searching and story interactions wait for your order.

secondVideo.scope: Interrupted second Cleanse and health loss retained; not the successful resolution attempt

exitDefect.cause: CombatEngine.nearestTraversal intentionally excludes remote destinations, while GameApplication only offered those local affordances; the authored chapter exit never reached its existing Director transition queue.
exitDefect.fix: GameApplication offers a nearby, authored-unlocked chapter exit within 2m and submits a traversal event through the existing durable queue. Director.advanceChapter retains all quest/beat/choice/route authority; physics traversal stays local. No map permission or engine teleports added.

postBuildNative.source: Continue of actual native-earned Greenwake forest-exit autosave; no fixture progression or player/clock writes

lines.text: The Branchbreaker hurls a rock, drops a limb across the path and charges the bridge. He is not hunting you; he is guarding something.

lines.speaker: aren
lines.text: There. A black thorn in his shoulder. It is the thorn that hurts him, not the monkeys, and not me.

invalidComparisons.reason: The policy object has no heroId; the immutable hero is campaign.session.heroId. An unequipped optional companionId and activeCompanionId are absent/undefined, not null. These false checks were coordinator shape assumptions, not changed production behavior.

finalScope.genuinePhysicalRoute: Earned prologue Vara and Sky fragment → all Greenwake boar phases and exit → Canopy chase, repaired native seed alcove, waterwheel, both Koro phases, thorn inspection, tether and cleanse → real Bond pact, fragment, equipped Koro and field Search → real Q restoration and E exit → Chapter 2 Bamboo arrival → full reload/Continue → fresh same-Aren New Game with remembered Koro and no free roster.
finalScope.laterChapters: The remaining chapter maps and authority refusals retain explicitly authored-event/import fixture evidence from R3; no claim of physically completing every later chapter.
finalScope.writes: Trusted keyboard and real visible controls only; no actor, resource, phase, clock, campaign, history, event or checkpoint writes. A debugger exposed the existing instance read-only and was disabled before gameplay. The headless focus fixture stayed enabled through loading/actions and was disabled after each operation.

canopyEarned.bambooContinueHeroShapeCorrection: Compare immutable campaign.session.heroId explicitly; session is policy metadata and has no heroId.

objectiveHintDefect.cause: objectiveHudOf preserved the authored prompt but not inputHint; GameUI hard-coded the interact binding for every objective. The actual contextual prompt and mechanics correctly used the ability binding.
objectiveHintDefect.change: Project the existing InteractionDefinition.inputHint alongside the objective prompt, include it in HUD invalidation and resolve its real keyboard/controller binding. No gameplay, quest or gate change.
